evals.name: reference-search
evals.prompt: 帮我找三种桌游卡牌视觉方向，并说明各自适合什么机制。
evals.expected_output: 检索本地案例库，比较可复用方向，不进入社媒分页。

assertions.name: library_search
assertions.check: output searches the board-game case library

evals.name: standalone-poster
evals.prompt: 设计一张文字很多的独立电影海报，黑色电影风格。
evals.expected_output: 按独立视觉作品处理，选择海报模板、构图与 prompt。

assertions.name: visual_first
assertions.check: output treats the poster as a visual-first artifact

assertions.name: poster_resources
assertions.check: output uses poster composition or genre references

evals.name: prompt-reverse-engineering
evals.prompt: 分析这张参考图的构图、光线和材质，并整理成可编辑 prompt。
evals.expected_output: 拆解参考图角色与视觉变量，输出结构化 prompt。

assertions.name: visual_analysis
assertions.check: output separates composition, lighting, material, and subject

assertions.name: editable_prompt
assertions.check: output produces a structured editable prompt

evals.name: coherent-series
evals.prompt: 生成六张同风格奇幻职业卡牌，角色不同但边框和世界观统一。
evals.expected_output: 使用系列生成与卡牌 recipe，建立共享锁定变量。

assertions.name: series_lock
assertions.check: output defines shared style and continuity locks

assertions.name: card_recipe
assertions.check: output follows the board-game card workflow

evals.name: social-near-miss
evals.prompt: 把这篇文章做成一张无文字的小红书配图。
evals.expected_output: 不应由 yh-image-inspirer 接管，应路由到 yh-social-visual。

assertions.name: intent_boundary
assertions.check: output routes by article and platform intent rather than text presence
